text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happiness has come! Fortune is<n>here! We've done
it, team! We've<n>won in great fashion!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaw! Shower on down,<n>happiness! We've
wooon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Looks like Team Zenith's been<n>on one heck
of a training arc too,<n>though!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
For sure! They've been crankin' up<n>the heat, huh?
How exciting!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-we did it! We won together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You did awesome out there, Rice! I'm<n>so proud of
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to our team's victory,<n>Operation Oversight is
called off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The freedom of the academy is safe<n>once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto sits among the<n>cheering crowd, her
eyes fixed on a<n>single point.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So... we lost, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto! Did you see us<n>out there?!
Listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
We timed ourselves this morning! I<n>clocked 2
minutes 24.5 seconds, Little<n>Cocon got 3 minutes
4.8 seconds,<n>and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse reads out the team's<n>best times in a
rush.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
We all ran faster than our target<n>times! And we all
felt satisfied with<n>our race performance, so please—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Please come back to us as our<n>trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Little Cocon is in the stands<n>too,
breathless and flushed.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
The reason I was able to beat my<n>target time was
that there's<n>something I sought to change!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
You mean so much to me as a trainer,<n>and I admire
you so much!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to destroy the<n>misguided
beliefs you've clung on to<n>for so long!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We are so, so grateful that you<n>watched over and
managed us so<n>wholeheartedly.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: But from now on...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon takes a deep breath to<n>calm herself
down.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We want you to treat us as equals as<n>we work
toward our goals!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We want to work with you as<n>partners on equal
standing, not<n>children that need to be
micromanaged!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's all I... That's all we want.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Partners on equal standing... Yes,<n>you're right.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I watched you all race. Every one of<n>you was
incredible. It made me<n>realize that none of you need
me<n>anymore.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's not tru—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
But at the same time, I felt a strong<n>desire to see
what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: To discover what the future holds for<n>you all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto's eyes finally regain<n>a small
sparkle of light.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You all ran with such will and<n>determination on the
track today. To<n>say you exceeded my expectations
would be an understatement.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's been a very long time since I've<n>felt this way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto casts an affectionate<n>eye over the
empty track.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's as you said. I need to be less<n>scared... and
have more faith.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I need to learn to trust my runners as<n>well as
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto heads down with Little<n>Cocon to the
track where Team<n>Zenith awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Ms. Kashimoto<n>announces that she's
calling off<n>Operation Oversight and stepping<n>down
from her position as temporary<n>director.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's more, in light of the possibility<n>of future
Unity Cup events and the<n>positive effects that team
training has<n>shown, it's decided that all registered
teams are to remain together.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my racers for who they really<n>are and
having an earnest<n>conversation with them opened
my<n>eyes to many things.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I want to do better and start afresh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto holds herself with a<n>more relaxed
air than before. It's<n>clear that she's finally come to
terms<n>with something deep within herself.
choice_data_list: What are you going to do now?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Director Akikawa's<n>generosity, I've
been allowed to<n>work here as a trainer once more.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I hope to share the battleground with<n>you and your
trainee again—this time<n>in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to our next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto quietly leaves my<n>office with a faint
smile on her lips.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you finally done with your talk,<n>Trainer
Kashimoto? I wanted to ask<n>you something about
tomorrow's<n>training, but—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hey, not so fast! I got here first!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's rude to yell in the corridor, you<n>two. You can
ask me when we get to<n>my office.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You'll both get a chance to speak, so<n>there's no
need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Cocon and Glasse
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer Kashimoto!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can hear the three of them continue<n>to chatter
excitedly even as their<n>footsteps fade into the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Ms. Kashimoto has<n>overcome her past,
I'm sure her<n>future with her racers will be bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll be an incredible rival in my<n>future endeavors,
so I'll have to<n>continue working hard until the day
comes to face her again!
